EndpointUrl.title: SipPulse transcript ingestion endpoint
EndpointUrl.description: HTTPS URL on api.sippulse.com that receives vCon payloads.

BearerToken.title: Temporary ingestion bearer token
BearerToken.description: Optional pilot credential. Prefer SipPulse SSO for production.

CaptureEnabled.title: Enable meeting capture
CaptureEnabled.description: Allows employees to capture Google Meet captions after consent.

PreferredTranscription.title: Preferred transcription source
PreferredTranscription.description: SipPulse AI requires one user click per meeting; Google captions remain the fallback.

AllowedEmailDomains.title: Allowed collaborator email domains
AllowedEmailDomains.description: Chrome profile email domains allowed to capture. Defaults to sippulse.com.
